To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the supplementation with Cu at 25% of its daily requirement had a beneficial effect on bone and cartilage development in growing broiler chickens and that phytase supplementation improved bone and cartilage traits in Cu-supplemented chickens.

dietary phytase addition to a Cu-deficient diet of broiler chickens improves weight gain, final body weight, bone geometry, and yield; additionally, it improves the thickness of the articular cartilage, and the thickness of particular zones of the growth plate.
dietary Cu at a lowered level (4 mg Cu kg−1 diet) with phytase supplementation had positive effects on the bone metabolism and cartilage development in growing broilers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of dietary Cu supplementation on the growth, bone development, and cartilage development in growing broilers.
the influence of dietary phytase on bone metabolism and cartilage development of broiler chickens fed with Cu from organic source at the reduced level of 25%.
the effect of dietary phytase supplementation on bone and hyaline cartilage development of broilers fed with organic complexed copper in a Cu-deficient diet.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
dietary phytase supplementation to Cu-supplemented diet had a positive effect in the growth and bone and cartilage development of broilers fed with a Cu-deficient diet.
the addition of Cu to a low Cu-containing diet and the addition of phytease to the same diet have positive effects on bone development and hyaline cartilage development of growing broiler chickens.
the supplementation with Cu and phytate in the diet of growing broilers had positive effects on bone and cartilage development.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

Cu supplementation at 25% of daily requirement in a Cu-deficient diet is beneficial for bone metabolism and that phytase addition to a diet with Cu supplementation improves bone geometry and cartilage development in broilers.
phytase supplementation to Cu-deficient broiler chickens is beneficial in the development of bone and cartilage, and the supplementation with phytase is recommended for Cu-supplemented broilers.

the addition of phytic acid to diets containing organic Cu can be used to enhance the growth performance of broilers, and the addition of phystase to the diet containing organic Cu can improve bone and cartilage development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of Cu and phytases in a Cu-deficient diet may be a useful tool to enhance growth performance, skeletal development, and cartilage growth of broiler chickens.
phytase supplementation is an important factor in the development of bone and cartilage in broilers.
Cu is an important element for the proper growth of broiler chickens.
